metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of EffectConnect, the marketplace integration platform of the Katapull group: channel connectivity, catalogue and content, pricing, orders and fulfilment, insights and platform foundation.

rootGroups.name: Channel Connectivity and Integration
rootGroups.description: Connections to marketplaces, feed channels, webshops, back offices, developers and embedded partners.

bricks.name: Marketplace Connector Framework
bricks.description: One canonical model and a library of adapters for 50+ European marketplaces (bol, Amazon, Kaufland, Decathlon, MediaMarkt, eBay, Praxis, Hornbach and others), absorbing each marketplace's API, rate limits and changes so merchants and partners integrate once.

modules.name: Channel API
modules.description: Internal API to list channels, push offers and pull orders through any adapter.

modules.name: Channel Sync Scheduler
modules.description: Schedules pulls and pushes per channel connection respecting each marketplace's limits.

modules.name: Canonical Channel Mapping
modules.description: Translates between the canonical offer, order and shipment model and marketplace-specific payloads.

modules.name: Channel Adapter Registry
modules.description: Versions of each marketplace adapter, supported features and countries.

modules.name: Marketplace API Adapters
modules.description: Adapters for bol Retailer API, Amazon Selling Partner API, Mirakl-based marketplaces and other marketplace APIs.

brickDependencies.description: Reads connection settings and credentials per channel.

dataDependencies.description: Uses category and attribute definitions to build payloads.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: European marketplaces (bol, Amazon, Kaufland, Decathlon, MediaMarkt, eBay and others)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Offers, orders and statuses are exchanged through each marketplace's seller API.

bricks.name: Channel Onboarding and Configuration
bricks.description: Guided connection of a merchant or partner customer to a marketplace: authentication, country and fulfilment settings, order flow options and exceptions, configured together with the EffectConnect onboarding team.

modules.name: Channel Setup Wizard
modules.description: Step-by-step connection and settings per marketplace.

modules.name: Channel Settings Store
modules.description: Settings per connection: countries, fulfilment mode, order statuses, shipping methods.

modules.name: Marketplace Authorisation Connector
modules.description: OAuth and API-key flows with marketplaces.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for connections and their credentials.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Seller grants access to its marketplace account.

bricks.name: Feed Manager
bricks.description: Builds and schedules product feeds for marketing and comparison channels (Google Shopping, Meta, Beslist, Tweakers, Daisycon, TikTok) from the central catalogue; Platform includes five exports, more via feed credits.

modules.name: Feed Builder
modules.description: Selects products, maps fields and previews feed output.

modules.name: Feed Export Worker
modules.description: Generates and publishes feed files on schedule.

modules.name: Feed Destination Connectors
modules.description: Delivery to Google Merchant Center, Meta catalogues, comparison sites and affiliate networks.

brickDependencies.description: Uses product selections to scope feeds.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Advertising and comparison channels (Google, Meta, Beslist, Tweakers, Daisycon, TikTok)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.interface: Product feed files and catalogue APIs

subGroups.name: Commerce System Connections
subGroups.description: Inbound connections from merchant systems and partners.

bricks.name: Webshop Platform Plugins
bricks.description: Apps and plugins for Shopify, Lightspeed, Magento, WooCommerce, Shopware, PrestaShop and CCV Shop that sync products, stock and orders between the webshop and the hub; the fastest route to go live (about two weeks according to EffectConnect).

modules.name: Webshop Connector API
modules.description: Endpoint the plugins call to exchange products, stock and orders.

modules.name: Webshop Sync Consumer
modules.description: Processes product and stock events from plugins and pushes orders back.

brickDependencies.description: Exports marketplace orders to the webshop.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Webshop platforms (Shopify, Lightspeed, Magento, WooCommerce, Shopware, PrestaShop, CCV Shop)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of products and destination of orders.

bricks.name: Back-office and ERP Connectors
bricks.description: Native connectors to back-office systems, prioritising Katapull siblings (Logic4, Vendit, Highbiza) and partner middleware (for example OrderChief, KING ERP via agencies), so products, stock and orders flow without custom development.

modules.name: Back-office Sync Consumer
modules.description: Processes catalogue and stock changes and exports orders.

modules.name: Back-office Connectors
modules.description: Connectors to Logic4, Vendit, Highbiza and middleware partners.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Katapull back offices (Logic4, Vendit, Highbiza) and partner middleware
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Systems of record for products, stock and orders at merchants.

bricks.name: Public Merchant API
bricks.description: Documented REST API (v3) for merchants, developers and middleware to manage products, offers, stock and orders, with authentication, throttling and webhooks.

modules.name: REST API v3
modules.description: Product, offer, stock and order endpoints.

modules.name: Webhook Dispatcher
modules.description: Pushes order and status events to subscribers.

modules.name: API Authentication and Throttling
modules.description: Validates keys and applies rate limits.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Merchant ERP, PIM, WMS and middleware (e.g. OrderChief)

bricks.name: Embedded Partner Integrations
bricks.description: Partner API and white-label branded pages that let WMS, TMS and other SaaS vendors (DeliveryMatch named) offer marketplace order and shipment connections inside their own platform, with uniform data and partner-defined pricing.

modules.name: Branded Connection Pages
modules.description: White-label pages where partner customers authenticate and manage marketplace settings.

modules.name: Partner API
modules.description: Available channels, connected channels per customer, order retrieval and shipment updates.

modules.name: Uniform Order Format
modules.description: Delivers orders from every marketplace in one schema.

modules.name: Partner Tenant Registry
modules.description: Partners, their customers, branding and commercial terms.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: SaaS partners (DeliveryMatch, WMS and TMS vendors)

bricks.name: App Store and Partner Ecosystem
bricks.description: Catalogue of apps and partners (optimisation, analytics, enrichment, logistics, customer service, finance) that extend the hub, plus listings for agency and logistics partners.

modules.name: App Install API
modules.description: Installs and authorises apps for an account.

modules.name: App Listing Service
modules.description: App metadata, categories and partner details.

brickDependencies.description: Apps act through the public API.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Publish apps that extend the hub.

rootGroups.name: Catalog and Content
rootGroups.description: The central catalogue and everything needed to turn it into accepted, localised listings.

bricks.name: Product Catalog Hub
bricks.description: Central catalogue that merges products, prices and stock from webshops, back offices and extra XML, CSV or Google Sheets feeds, with product families, bundles and multilingual content.

modules.name: Feed Import Worker
modules.description: Imports and merges additional product feeds.

modules.name: Product Master Service
modules.description: Products, variants, families and bundles keyed by EAN.

modules.name: File and Sheet Importers
modules.description: XML, CSV and Google Sheets readers.

brickDependencies.description: Enforces article (EAN) allowance of the plan.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for the merchant's marketplace catalogue.

bricks.name: Dynamic Product Selections
bricks.description: Rule-based product selections (brand, category, margin, stock, performance) that decide which products go to which marketplace, feed or repricer strategy and update automatically.

bricks.name: Content Mapping and Validation
bricks.description: Maps catalogue data to each marketplace's categories, required attributes and allowed values in bulk, and validates listings before they are sent.

modules.name: Category Schema Refresh
modules.description: Refreshes marketplace category and attribute schemas.

modules.name: Listing Validator
modules.description: Checks listings against required attributes and allowed values.

modules.name: Category Schema Cache
modules.description: Current category trees and attribute rules per marketplace.

bricks.name: Smart Data and Custom Attribute Rules
bricks.description: Rule engine that creates new data from conditions and logic, such as channel-specific titles, derived attributes and corrections, so content is optimised per channel without editing products one by one.

modules.name: Rule Engine
modules.description: Evaluates rules on products per channel.

bricks.name: Content Translation
bricks.description: Automatic translation of product content for marketplaces, feeds and customers in other countries; multilingual catalogues are included and AI translation is an add-on module.

modules.name: Translation Worker
modules.description: Batches content to the translation provider.

rootGroups.name: Pricing and Competitiveness
rootGroups.description: Price formulas, repricing and competitive intelligence.

bricks.name: Price Calculation and Planning
bricks.description: Calculates base prices per marketplace from purchase cost, commission, fixed costs and currency conversion, and plans promotions over time.

modules.name: Price Formula Builder
modules.description: Builds price formulas from cost variables.

modules.name: Price Calculator
modules.description: Evaluates formulas, floors and currency conversion.

bricks.name: Repricer and Buy Box Engine
bricks.description: Continuously re-evaluates every selected offer against competing offers and buy box holders, applying strategies per marketplace and product selection (compete with qualifying sellers only, step up when holding the buy box, look-alike, brand mode, grade matching) within min and max prices.

modules.name: Repricer Dashboard
modules.description: Buy box positions, price changes and results.

modules.name: Repricing Loop
modules.description: Re-evaluates all selected offers on a fixed cadence regardless of catalogue size.

modules.name: Strategy Evaluator
modules.description: Applies buy box scenarios and floors to compute a new price.

modules.name: Price History Store
modules.description: History of own price changes and buy box states.

brickDependencies.description: Floor and base prices from formulas.

bricks.name: Competitor Offer Analysis
bricks.description: Collects competing offers per product and marketplace (seller, price, delivery promise, rating), finds look-alike products and shows who competes where (Aanbieder Analyse add-on).

modules.name: Offer Analysis API
modules.description: Competing offers and buy box holders.

modules.name: Look-alike Matcher
modules.description: Matches similar products from other sellers.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Marketplace competitive pricing endpoints and notifications

rootGroups.name: Orders, Stock and Fulfilment
rootGroups.description: Order lifecycle, stock synchronisation and marketplace fulfilment.

bricks.name: Marketplace Order Hub
bricks.description: Imports orders from all connected marketplaces, normalises them into one format, routes them to the webshop, back office, WMS or partner, and tracks their lifecycle.

modules.name: Order Overview
modules.description: Orders, statuses and exceptions across marketplaces.

modules.name: Order Normaliser
modules.description: Maps marketplace orders to the canonical order.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for marketplace orders in the hub.

bricks.name: Shipment and Order Status Sync
bricks.description: Sends shipment confirmations with carrier and tracking code, cancellations and return statuses back to each marketplace within its deadlines.

modules.name: Shipment API
modules.description: Receives shipment and status updates from back offices and partners.

modules.name: Status Sync Worker
modules.description: Pushes updates to marketplaces and handles rejections.

modules.name: Carrier Code Mapper
modules.description: Maps carriers and shipping methods to marketplace codes.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of carrier and tracking codes.

bricks.name: Stock Synchronisation and Locations
bricks.description: Keeps available-to-sell stock correct on every channel by combining stock from multiple locations with buffers and pushing changes in near real time.

modules.name: Stock Locations View
modules.description: Quantities, purchase and sales value per location; Excel export.

modules.name: Available-to-sell Calculator
modules.description: Applies buffers and location rules per channel.

bricks.name: Fulfilment Manager
bricks.description: Decides per order whether to ship from own or marketplace warehouses (Logistiek via bol, Fulfilment by Amazon), switches LVB offers to own stock when needed, prepares replenishment shipments with labels and raises stock alarms.

modules.name: LVB Switch Daemon
modules.description: Moves offers between marketplace and own fulfilment to protect the delivery promise.

modules.name: Fulfilment Routing Rules
modules.description: Rules by time, stock or product type.

modules.name: Replenishment Planner
modules.description: Inbound shipment plans, splits and registrations.

modules.name: Marketplace Fulfilment Connectors
modules.description: LVB and FBA inbound and inventory APIs.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Marketplace fulfilment programmes (Logistiek via bol, Fulfilment by Amazon)

rootGroups.name: Insights and Growth
rootGroups.description: Reporting, retail media and optimisation advice.

bricks.name: Sales Reporting and Insights
bricks.description: Reporting and data insights on revenue, orders, buy box and margin per marketplace, product and period, with Google Analytics integration and exports.

modules.name: Metrics Aggregation Worker
modules.description: Aggregates order, price and stock events.

modules.name: Analytics Export
modules.description: Sends sales events to Google Analytics.

bricks.name: Retail Media Dashboard
bricks.description: Brings retail media campaign and trade-deal performance from several retailers into one comparable dashboard, via retail media APIs (Amazon, bol, Albert Heijn), Criteo or manual entry; developed with OMG Transact.

modules.name: Retail Media Dashboard
modules.description: Aggregate, segment and drill down by retailer, category and product line.

modules.name: Retail Media API
modules.description: Campaigns, trade deals and manual entries.

modules.name: Retail Media Connectors
modules.description: Retailer retail media APIs and Criteo.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Retail media networks (Amazon, bol, Albert Heijn) and Criteo

bricks.name: Account Health and Optimisation Advice
bricks.description: Gives EffectConnect consultants and merchants a view of account health (sync errors, rejections, buy box, stock-outs) and the optimisation advice EffectConnect provides after go-live. Scoring logic is a modeled inference.

rootGroups.name: Platform Foundation
rootGroups.description: Accounts, plans, identity, integration runtime and support.

bricks.name: Accounts, Plans and Entitlements
bricks.description: Merchant accounts, Platform and Scale plans, add-on modules (extra products, marketplaces, feed credits, repricer, offer analysis, fulfilment manager, AI translation) and metering of articles and orders against allowances.

modules.name: Usage Meter
modules.description: Counts active articles (EAN) and orders per month.

modules.name: Entitlement Checker
modules.description: Answers whether a module or allowance is available.

bricks.name: Identity and Access
bricks.description: User accounts, roles and API keys for merchants, partners and EffectConnect staff, with the access control needed for marketplace credentials and consumer order data.

bricks.name: Integration Runtime and Monitoring
bricks.description: Shared job queue, retries, rate-limit governance, event log and monitoring for every sync between back offices, the hub and marketplaces, built for high order volumes and peaks.

modules.name: Integration Monitor
modules.description: Failed jobs, retries and marketplace errors per account.

bricks.name: Implementation and Support Desk
bricks.description: Tracks onboarding projects (get to know, bring data together, set up strategy, go live) and support contacts by email, chat and phone in Dutch, English and German, plus the knowledge base.

modules.name: Implementation Tracker
modules.description: Onboarding steps and go-live status per account.

modules.name: Helpdesk Connector
modules.description: Ticketing, chat and knowledge base tools.
